purpose: Defines ERROR-LOG-RECORD, the 122-byte application error log record of the authorization module. COPAUA0C fills it (date, time, transaction, program, location code, level, subsystem, codes, message, event key) and writes it to the CICS transient data queue CSSL; the ERR-LEVEL value 'C' (critical) makes COPAUA0C terminate the task.

key_fields.name: ERR-LOCATION
key_fields.meaning: 4-character code of the failing point (e.g. M001, A001, C001, I001).

key_fields.name: ERR-LEVEL
key_fields.meaning: Severity: L log, I info, W warning, C critical.

key_fields.name: ERR-SUBSYSTEM
key_fields.meaning: Subsystem: A app, C CICS, I IMS, D DB2, M MQ, F file.

key_fields.name: ERR-EVENT-KEY
key_fields.meaning: Business key of the failing event (card number, account or customer id).

observations.text: ERR-LOG, ERR-INFO, ERR-DB2 and ERR-FILE values are never set by COPAUA0C.
